query: Canonical report of `cannot import name 'pad' from 'kornia.geometry.transform.pyramid'` after kornia 0.8.3 removed the accidental torch.nn.functional.pad re-export — pack-wide import failure.

desired.outcome: Multiple confirmed fixes: pin kornia 0.8.2/0.7.3/0.6.12, or one-line patch importing pad from torch.nn.functional in pyramid_blending.py (omniscia's patch confirmed by nammmmm); PRs #506/#516/#498 sat unmerged while the break persisted for months.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
